lines.en: -Presenting the award for favorite returning male character is Mackenzie...
-This is it. This is it. This is my category.
-Oh, my God. Do I have a speech?
-Do you got your gracious loser face?
-Now, Joey, remember, if you win, you'll have to hug me. You hug me.
-In the category of favorite returning male character, the nominees are...
-Gavin Graham from The Young and the Restless.
-And Joey Tribbiani from Days of Our Lives.
